rounds.text: Mangalam Alloys Ltd is currently trading at a deep value inflection point, evidenced by a P/E ratio of 5.38x [E1] and a price-to-book ratio of 0.50x [E2]. These valuations represent a massive discount compared to the sector benchmarks of 23.64x for P/E [E6] and 2.58x for P/B [E7]. This undervaluation persists despite the company delivering a robust 32.7% CAGR in profit growth over the last five years [E55]. Recent momentum is shifting, as evidenced by a 34% YoY increase in sales [E62] and a signal that profit growth is now significantly outpacing the recent share price decline [E52]. Conceded: the stock sits at the bottom 6% of its 52-week range [E5], has seen a 59% decline in share price over the last year [E20], and currently offers a 0.00% dividend yield [E4]. Furthermore, conceded: the ROA of 0.67% significantly trails the sector benchmark of 4.68% [E8], and recent earnings growth is showing signs of deceleration [E67].
